78347.subject: The Ultimate Guide to Grok Bot: The First Real AI Agent OS 🤖
78347.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/grok-bot-guide

👋 Hey, Linas here! Every day, I break down 3 stories shaping the future of FinTech & Artificial Intelligence - plus the money movements and trends worth tracking. First time here? 400k+ FinTech and AI leaders get this daily. Join them:
Grok Bot went from a $200/month product to a $20/month one in just 15 days. SpaceXAI [ https://substack.com/redirect/d207697e-196f-4da8-8f02-bb33673747c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] launched it in early beta on August 11, 2026, available only to SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra, and Cursor Teams Premium subscribers [ https://substack.com/redirect/b40b6c55-20f5-4208-95ae-6756da848dda?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. By August 26, every paid Cursor and SuperGrok plan included it.
Which means that Grok Bot is now cheap enough that almost anyone reading this can try it today, and most who do will get just motion rather than real results. And the key reason is structural rather than a matter of prompting harder.
In short, Grok Bot is the persistent AI agent product from SpaceXAI, the SpaceX division formerly known as xAI, and it is not Grok in a chat window.
→ Named Bots share one cloud computer with a browser, filesystem, and terminal; they sign into your existing tools, run scheduled routines, reuse saved skills, hand work to one another, and keep going while your laptop is closed.
→ A well-designed Bot can notice work, assemble context, operate software, and produce an inspectable artifact.
The catch is all in the architecture. You sign in with a Cursor account, and every Bot on that account shares the computer’s files, browser sessions, and command-line credentials, so each new Bot can reach everything the existing ones already can. The launch post promised that “Bots have their own computer.” The documentation published the same day says the computer is assigned per user and warns against using separate Bots as a security boundary.
That gap between the marketing and the manual pretty much explains most Grok Bot failures: people take the marketing literally and treat the product as staff rather than as an operating loop. They create a vague generalist, connect too many systems, ask for an ambitious result without a definition of done, and schedule the task before they have watched it fail. The Bot thus produces motion rather than a dependable outcome. Adding more Bots then multiplies handoffs, duplicated work, usage, and error propagation 🤷‍♂️
Meanwhile, an AI agent OS is the operating layer that turns a model into a workforce: persistent roles, shared tools, durable state, scheduled work, handoffs, approvals, and evidence, all in one place. Pieces of that have existed for years in coding agents, workflow tools, and orchestration frameworks, but they lived in separate products and needed an engineer to wire them together. Highlights
 
Aave App Enters Early Access on iOS
Early access to the Aave App started on August 26 on iOS. The first cohort of users received Ghost Passes, which are invites that
let friends and family skip the waitlist. More passes are being given out through the Aave Instagram, Telegram, and on X.
Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2092643144139424046].
 
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks Coming to V4
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks went live on Base, and Aave V4 will be the first credit market to fully support them. Once V4 is
deployed on Base, users will be able to borrow stablecoins against tokenized stocks. Only available in eligible geos outside the
U.S. Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2091964981675704495].
 
Aave V4 Crosses $800M Deposits
Aave V4 crossed $800 million deposits on August 27, while active loans set a new all-time high. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2093013562788598243].
 
New incentives are also live for USDC borrowers [https://x.com/aave/status/2094433298567090579] in the Core Hub on Ethereum.
Borrow USDC against any available collateral and earn 2% back in USDC rewards.
 
EtherFi Cash Now Runs on V4
EtherFi moved its Cash credit backend to a dedicated Aave V4 instance on Optimism, letting more than 100,000 cardholders borrow
against their portfolios. Supported collateral includes PAXG, SPYx, WBTC, ETH, and ETHFI, with more coming as the integration
expands. Deposits on the deployment crossed $100 million in its first week. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2088265181230969095].
